title: All 71 expression functions are invisible to the script editor's autocomplete
existing_state: The engine registers 71 unique built-in functions across 8 categories (verified by extracting every Register() call in Services/Scripting/Functions/*.cs), and FunctionRegistry already exposes them programmatically via RegisteredNames (FunctionRegistry.cs:90). The Scintilla editor's ScriptAutocompleteProvider never touches any of this: a grep for 'function' in ScriptAutocompleteProvider.cs returns zero hits. Interpolation completion (the `${`/`{{` context, ScriptAutocompleteProvider.cs:44-45, 319, 450-456) offers only the 10 hardcoded BuiltInSymbols (lines 92-104), variables scraped from the script text, and host-grid columns — so typing `${jso` or writing a `set:` expression gets no help for json.get, regex_match, date_add, ip_in_cidr, etc. Users must keep SCRIPTING.md open to recall names and arity. Related but distinct: FLOW_CANVAS_ENHANCEMENTS.md:254-256 ('Engine Codex') proposes a bundled function catalog with signature help for the React canvas's code fields — that roadmap item explicitly notes the metadata (arity/help/examples) is not machine-readable today, and it does not cover the WinForms Scintilla editor at all.
recommendation: Phase 1 (cheap): inject FunctionRegistry.RegisteredNames into the interpolation and set-expression completion contexts in ScriptAutocompleteProvider — names-only completion with the category as the Detail string, mirroring how CommandDescriptions feeds command completion (lines 116-161). Phase 2: extend the IFunctionCategory registration API with signature/description metadata (the exact prerequisite the Engine Codex roadmap item needs), then surface calltips in Scintilla and reuse the same generated catalog for the canvas — one metadata investment serving both editors.
user_benefit: The expression library is the engine's power feature, and right now it is discoverable only by reading a 6,400-line markdown file; name completion alone would let users find string/JSON/network helpers at the moment they need them.

evidence.note: interpolation completion = 10 hardcoded symbols + scraped variables + host columns; zero function references in file
RegisteredNames already exposes all 71 names — unused by the editor
roadmap covers the React-canvas side only and flags the missing metadata; Scintilla editor not in scope there
